title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is given as R(θ)=1/1000*sum{i=1}{3}{abs(x_i-θ)}. This is a sum of absolute differences between each data point and θ, scaled by $$\frac{1}{1000}$$.

title: Median Minimizes Absolute Differences
text: The value of θ that minimizes the sum of absolute differences is the median of the data points. This is because the median minimizes the sum of absolute deviations.

title: Finding the Median
text: Given the data points {1, $$6$$, 17}, what is the median?

title: Verify the Median
text: To verify, calculate the absolute differences for each data point with $$\theta=6$$: $$|1-6|$$, $$|6-6|$$, $$|17-6|$$. Sum these differences and compare with other potential θ values.
